                                  14          All discovery in this matter has been referred to the undersigned. [Dkt. 74]. On October 9,

                                  15   2025, the Parties filed a joint letter brief raising several discovery disputes. [Dkt. 165]. On

                                  16   October 30, 2025, the Court issued an Order setting a Discovery Management Conference for

                                  17   December 11, 2025. [Dkt. 196]. That Order explicitly directed pro se Defendant Philip A. Ward

                                  18   to appear in person for the December 11, 2025 hearing. Id. (“The Court ORDERS that the

                                  19   Parties' lead trial counsel, any other counsel necessarily knowledgeable about and working on

                                  20   discovery, and all pro se parties (including Mr. Ward) MUST ALL APPEAR IN PERSON at the

                                  21   Discovery Management Conference.”).

                                  22          On December 11, 2025, the Court held the noticed hearing regarding the multiple

                                  23   discovery disputes and to discuss overall discovery management in this case. Despite six weeks’

                                  24   notice of the December 11, 2025 hearing and an explicit Order of the Court requiring his in-person

                                  25   attendance, Defendant Ward failed to appear at the December 11, 2025 hearing. Defendant Ward

                                  26   did not file a motion requesting rescheduling of the hearing, he did not file a motion seeking leave

                                  27   to attend the hearing remotely, and he did not contact the Court’s staff to raise any issue about his

                                  28   attendance at the hearing.
                                         Case 3:24-cv-05639-TLT           Document 197        Filed 12/12/25     Page 2 of 2




                                   1             Despite Judge Thompson’s directive that he find new counsel by no later than November

                                   2   12, 2025, no counsel has yet entered appearance for Defendant Ward. See Dkt. 172. At the

                                   3   December 11, 2025 hearing, counsel for Dasagroup indicated that they were in discussions with

                                   4   Defendant Ward regarding the possibility of such counsel eventually being retained to represent

                                   5   Defendant Ward in this action. Counsel for Dasagroup confirmed that, as of the date of the

                                   6   hearing, they were not yet counsel for Defendant Ward.

                                   7             Failure to comply with a court order may result in negative consequences such as monetary

                                   8   sanctions, discovery sanctions, civil contempt, and up to and including the potential for a report

                                   9   and recommendation for entry of judgment adverse to a non-complying party.

                                  10             Accordingly, Defendant Philip A. Ward is hereby ORDERED TO SHOW CAUSE as to

                                  11   why he failed to obey this Court’s October 30, 2025 Order and why the Court should not impose

                                  12   negative consequences (including but not limited to discovery sanctions, monetary sanctions, civil
Northern District of California
 United States District Court




                                  13   contempt finding, or other appropriate sanctions) on Defendant Ward for his failure to appear at

                                  14   the December 11, 2025 hearing.

                                  15             Defendant Philip A. Ward is ORDERED to file a written response to this Order to Show

                                  16   Cause explaining why he failed to appear and why sanctions should not be imposed, by no later

                                  17   than JANUARY 12, 2026. Failure to file a timely and adequate response to this Order to Show

                                  18   Cause may result in negative consequences, such as sanctions, for failure to comply with court

                                  19   orders.

                                  20             The Clerk of Court is DIRECTED to mail this Order to Show Cause to Defendant Ward at

                                  21   his address of record. Counsel for Dasagroup is ORDERED to send a copy of this Order to Show

                                  22   Cause to Defendant Ward via email by no later than December 15, 2025.

                                  23             IT IS SO ORDERED.

                                  24   Dated: December 12, 2025
